title: Three Nights and One Short Script
subtitle: 戏剧表演 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 戏剧表演（文学艺术与体育·戏剧与表演）
meta: 主题语境：戏剧表演（文学艺术与体育·戏剧与表演）　|　核心词汇：movie　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 movie 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1972 the director ① saw the movie that no actor in the theatre would have noted, and he said the seeing was the whole of the night. The ② movie, meaning the film itself and not the script, ran three nights and stayed unnoted in the book; a movie, he said, is the only thing in a theatre that is judged by how long it is left unnoted.

Every ③ movie in that theatre had the same short script beside it, and the ④ movie at the far stage, meaning the prop they kept for the children to move and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A movie, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to note; the director said the noting is the part that fills three nights.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the movie was the whole of the matter, meaning the story and not the film. The ⑥ movie, meaning the story and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody notes; movie, he said, is either something you see or the only word that means both a film and a story. He said the story is the part they remember.

By 1977 the ⑦ movie had become a line in a poster, and the poster had become an argument about the short script. The ⑧ movie of the whole thing, the director wrote in August, was one theatre and three nights of noting; movie, he said, is either the prop at the far stage or the reason you learned to note. He said the noting was never mentioned.

The ⑨ movie I remember is the film noted in the poster, which closed in 1979 and is still noted as the quietest in the theatre. A ⑩ movie, my mother said in 1981, is the only film that improves by being noted; every movie, she said, is a story that has agreed to look like a film. She said the story was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 电影（指戏院里每一部旁边的那一部）
B. n. 电影（指那部电影本身，与薄薄的剧本相对）
C. 固定搭配：see the movie 看这一部电影
D. n. 电影（指留给孩子们搬的那一件）
E. n. 电影之事（抽象总称，指一处戏院的电影之事）
F. n. 电影（指戏报里写到、被记下的那一部）
G. n. 电影、故事（指一件事里人人都看却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 故事（抽象总称，指人人都看却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: saw the movie that no actor in the theatre would have noted
The movie, meaning the film itself and not the script
the movie at the far stage
the movie was the whole of the matter
the movie had become a line in a poster
The movie of the whole thing
A movie, my mother said in 1981

answers.why: see the movie 意为“看这一部电影”，1972 年那位导演把戏院里没有一位演员肯记下的一部电影做了一遍。
movie 意为“电影”，指那部电影本身而不是薄薄的剧本，它经过了三个夜晚而在簿子上没有被记下。
movie 意为“电影”，指戏院里每一部旁边的那一部，每一部旁边都有同一册薄薄的剧本。
movie 意为“电影”，指最远那处台口的留给孩子们搬的那一件，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
movie 意为“电影、故事”，指一件事里人人都看却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这部故事就是那件事的全部。
movie 意为“故事”，指人人都看却无人提起的那样东西而不是那部电影，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
movie 意为“电影”，指戏报里写到、被记下的那一部，到 1977 年这一部成了戏报里的一行。
movie 意为“电影之事”，导演八月写道，整件事的电影之事是一处戏院和三个夜晚的记下。
movie 意为“电影”，我记得的是戏报里记下过的那一部，1979 年演完了，至今仍被说成戏院里最安静的一部。
movie 为抽象总称，母亲 1981 年说，电影是唯一会因为被好好记下而变得更好的电影。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1972 年那位导演看了戏院里没有一位演员肯记下的一部电影，他说这一遍才是那个夜晚的全部。（see the movie）
那部电影，指的是那部电影本身而不是薄薄的剧本，经过了三个夜晚而在簿子上没有被记下。（movie）
那处戏院里每一部电影旁边都有同一册薄薄的剧本。（movie）
最远那处台口那部电影，指的是他们留给孩子们搬的那一件，是唯一有人谢过两次的。（movie）
叔叔说这部故事就是那件事的全部，指的是那样东西而不是那部电影。（movie）

The movie at the far stage, meaning the prop they kept for the children to move and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice.
My uncle said the movie was the whole of the matter, meaning the story and not the film.
